crossrefs.text: and she conceived and gave birth to a son. “God has taken away my shame,” she said.
So the pride of man will be brought low, and the loftiness of men will be humbled; the LORD alone will be exalted in that day,
I will make man scarcer than pure gold, and mankind rarer than the gold of Ophir.
For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.
“The Lord has done this for me. In these days He has shown me favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.”
Because the LORD had closed Hannahʼs womb, her rival would provoke her viciously to taunt her.
The proud look of man will be humbled, and the loftiness of men brought low; the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.
Your men will fall by the sword, and your warriors in battle. And the gates of Zion will lament and mourn; destitute, she will sit on the ground.
And the LORD went before them in a pillar of cloud to guide their way by day, and in a pillar of fire to give them light by night, so that they could travel by day or night.
Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place before the people.
But who can endure the day of His coming? And who can stand when He appears? For He will be like a refinerʼs fire, like a laundererʼs soap.
And He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver; He will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver. Then they will present offerings to the LORD in righteousness.
For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall,
Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and He will reign wisely as King and will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
And you are to tell him that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Here is a man whose name is the Branch, and He will branch out from His place and build the temple of the LORD.
You led them with a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night, to light for them the way in which they should travel.
